description: Lightning F.53K 53-412, code C. Gate guard at Abdullah Al-Mubarak / Nawaf Al-Ahmad Air Base, the military side of Kuwait International Airport (Flickr 2016 'Gate-Guard'; Scramble: no code, serial presented as 412 in Arabic numerals; Thunder & Lightnings 'Kuwait International Airport', current 28 Nov 2021; AirHistory.net photo of Hunter 213 dated 16 Jan 2020 shows 'Lightning Mk53 412' behind it at the military gate). Coordinates are the airport reference point; whether the gate is visible from a public road is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Abdullah Al-Mubarak Air Base military gate

description: Unmarked Hunter F.57 'preserved at the military gate of the airport' with Lightning 412 behind it, photographed 16 Jan 2020 (AirHistory.net photo 265101, filed as serial 213). Kuwait's F.57 213 (c/n 8785) was photographed at Dunsfold before delivery (ABPic). The identity 213 for the gate airframe comes only from the AirHistory.net contributor; the airframe carries no serial.
museum_name: Abdullah Al-Mubarak Air Base military gate
